keyQuotes: The era of AI being used only for chatting is over.
With an agent that can do anything for you on your computer, the next goal is to push this capability to everyone.
By GPT-5.5, Codex's advantage had become too significant to ignore.
Directly writing code is a more effective way for AI to accomplish tasks on a computer, such as building complex spreadsheets.
Will the hundreds of millions of consumers accustomed to free 'chit-chat' and conversation ultimately be willing to pay for a digital agent that can work for them and help them earn a living?

mainPoints.explanation: OpenAI plans to fully integrate Codex into ChatGPT and connect it with external partner applications, enabling it to write code, manage schedules, and control software, becoming an agent platform that executes tasks for users.
mainPoints.point: ChatGPT will transition from a chatbot to a super app, with the core being the integration of the coding tool Codex.

mainPoints.explanation: GPT-5.5 is significantly better than its predecessor at handling long, multi-step tasks, requiring less frequent human guidance. This allows Codex to execute independently after receiving clear instructions, increasing developer trust.
mainPoints.point: The upgrade of the underlying GPT-5.5 model is a key driver of Codex's capability leap.

mainPoints.explanation: In the fall of 2024, Anthropic's coding capabilities surpassed OpenAI's. After releasing the Claude Code preview in February 2025, OpenAI quickly formed a Codex team and restructured its organization, merging the ChatGPT, Codex, and API teams.
mainPoints.point: Anthropic's Claude Code taking the lead was the direct catalyst for OpenAI's accelerated integration.

mainPoints.explanation: Codex users are mostly paid subscribers with high monetization efficiency. OpenAI has shelved consumer businesses like Sora to concentrate resources on enterprise clients, aiming to solidify its revenue data before going public.
mainPoints.point: With an IPO approaching, OpenAI needs to push Codex to its 900 million consumer users to drive willingness to pay.

mainPoints.explanation: OpenAI previously launched Operator to have AI simulate human actions in a browser, but it was too inefficient. Executives believe directly writing code is a more effective approach, aligning with Anthropic's path from Claude Code to Claude Cowork.
mainPoints.point: Directly writing code is more efficient than simulating human browser operations, positioning Codex as the core of a general-purpose agent.

oneSentenceSummary: OpenAI plans to integrate its coding tool Codex into ChatGPT, transforming it into a super app capable of writing code, managing schedules, and controlling software, marking a strategic shift from a chatbot to an AI agent platform.
originalTitle: ChatGPT 将迎来史上最大改版，“AI 只用来聊天的时代结束了”
summary: Based on exclusive reporting from the Financial Times, the article details OpenAI's largest redesign of ChatGPT since its 2022 launch. The core change involves integrating Codex, its fastest-growing programming tool, into ChatGPT and connecting it with external partner applications. The analysis unfolds across four dimensions: strategic intent, technological foundation, competitive pressure, and business logic. OpenAI executives believe the future of AI lies in agents that execute tasks for users, not simple conversations. The upgrade of the underlying GPT-5.5 model enables Codex to independently perform complex, multi-step tasks. Anthropic's Claude Code, which previously led OpenAI in coding capabilities, directly prompted OpenAI to rapidly form a Codex team and restructure its organization. With an IPO approaching, OpenAI needs to push Codex to its 900 million consumer users to drive willingness to pay. The article also notes that Codex's desktop app saw its user base grow sixfold in two months, surpassing 5 million weekly active users, and details OpenAI's decision to shelve consumer businesses like Sora to concentrate resources on enterprise clients.
title: ChatGPT to Undergo Biggest-Ever Redesign: "The Era of AI for Chatting Alone Is Over"
